handoff.plan:
game_type:
  camera_feed: hidden
  camera_feed_hidden_rationale: The ongoing project already uses an authored moonlit forest background
    to preserve the existing battle scene composition.
  ar_tracking: none
  core_loop_seconds: 7
  total_duration_seconds: 90
starter_template:
  mode: none
  rationale: No matching Effect House scaffold covers this existing alternating WaterBall duel with
    its turn-based mana actions.
mechanic_rationale: Continue the existing custom turn-based WaterBall duel; mana now enables a
  player attack buff or a defensive guard during the same established turn flow.
mechanic:
  class: other
  description: Automatic alternating WaterBall battle with mana regeneration, a once-per-turn player
    attack buff and a once-per-turn guard.
  parameters:
    max_hp: 100
    damage_min: 10
    damage_max: 15
    critical_chance: 0.15
    critical_multiplier: 2
    turn_order:
      - Player A
      - Bot B
    prepare_seconds: 10
    fight_now_skips_remaining_preparation: true
    max_mana: 10
    starting_mana: 5
    mana_regen_per_completed_turn: 1
    attack_button_cost: 2
    attack_damage_bonus: 0.75
    attack_button_uses_per_turn: 1
    attack_applies_to: Player A's attack in the current turn
    attack_input_window: Preparation and Fight banner before Player A's attack
    defense_button_cost: 3
    defense_damage_taken_multiplier: 0.2
    defense_button_uses_per_turn: 1
    defense_applies_to: Player A while Bot B attacks in the current turn
    defense_input_window: Until Bot B's attack begins
    defense_animation: defend_loop_downscale8x loops from Bot B attack start through impact
screens:
  - name: Battle
    role: gameplay
    initial_visible: true
    layout:
      - id: el.turn
        element: turnText
        position: top-center-safe
        content: Turn N
        kind: hud
      - id: el.prep
        element: countdownText
        position: below turn counter
        content: 10…1, then Fight
        kind: hud
      - id: el.fight_now
        element: FightNowButton with contained label
        position: centered below countdownText
        content: Fight Now; visible only during preparation
        kind: button
        interactive: true
      - id: el.player
        element: Mage_Player
        position: left side of forest path
        kind: playable
      - id: el.player_hp
        element: Player health bar
        position: above Player A
        content: 100 HP at full
        kind: hud
      - id: el.player_mana
        element: Mage_Player_ManaBar
        position: below Player A health bar
        content: 5/10 initially; +1 per completed turn
        kind: hud
      - id: el.bot
        element: Mage_Bot
        position: right side of forest path
        kind: playable
      - id: el.bot_hp
        element: Bot health bar
        position: above Bot B
        content: 100 HP at full
        kind: hud
      - id: el.bot_mana
        element: Mage_Bot_ManaBar
        position: below Bot B health bar
        content: 5/10 initially; +1 per completed turn
        kind: hud
      - id: el.attack
        element: Attack_Button
        position: existing upper-left position
        content: Costs 2 Player mana; grants +75% damage to Player A's attack this turn; one use per turn;
          active only when affordable and before Player A attacks
        kind: button
        interactive: true
      - id: el.defense
        element: Defense_Button
        position: existing lower-left position
        content: Costs 3 Player mana; arms one guard for the current turn; dims after use; active until Bot
          B's attack starts
        kind: button
        interactive: true
      - id: el.waterball
        element: WaterBallProjectile
        position: travels between the two characters
        kind: playable
      - id: el.impact
        element: WaterBallImpact
        position: at the target on hit
        kind: decoration
  - name: Result
    role: result
    initial_visible: false
    layout:
      - id: el.winner
        element: countdownText winner callout
        position: center upper

      - id: el.retry
        element: RetryButton with child label
        position: bottom-center-safe

        kind: button
        interactive: true
        bounds:
          x: -120
          y: -370

interactions:
  - kind: record_start_reset
    trigger: Effect playback starts or APJS.EventType.RecordStart fires
    response: Restore both fighters to 100 HP and 5/10 mana; clear attack and defense actions and start
      Turn 1 preparation.
    state_change: ANY → PREPARATION
  - kind: gameplay_action
    trigger: Preparation countdown reaches zero automatically
    response: Show Fight for one second, then Player A attacks Bot B; if Bot B survives, Bot B attacks
      Player A; restore 1 mana to both at the end of each completed turn, capped at 10.
    state_change: PREPARATION → A_ATTACK → B_ATTACK → PREPARATION
    target:
      scope: asset
      asset_ids:
        - asset.waterball_projectile
        - asset.waterball_impact
    feedback:
      visual: Attack GIF wind-up, WaterBall projectile growth and flight, impact burst, updated health and
        mana fills.
  - kind: gameplay_action
    trigger: Tap Attack_Button before Player A's attack when the button is active and Player A has at
      least 2 mana
    response: Spend 2 Player mana and increase Player A's current-turn attack damage by 75%; keep the
      button inactive after use until the turn ends. The buff does not affect Bot B.
    state_change: PRE-ATTACK → ATTACK-BOOSTED
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - el.attack
    feedback:
      visual: Show press feedback, reduce Player A's mana fill by 2/10, dim Attack_Button, and apply the
        buff to Player A's hit.
  - kind: gameplay_action
    trigger: Tap Defense_Button before Bot B's attack begins when the button is active and Player A has
      at least 3 mana
    response: Spend 3 Player mana and arm one guard for the current turn. When Bot B starts attacking,
      play Player A's looping defend animation until the WaterBall impacts; reduce the incoming
      final damage to 20% and suppress the normal hit animation. Keep the button inactive until the
      next turn.
    state_change: PRE-B_ATTACK → PLAYER-GUARD-ARMED → B_ATTACK → PREPARATION
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - el.defense
    feedback:
      visual: Show press feedback, reduce Player A's mana fill by 3/10, dim Defense_Button, loop the Mage
        shield animation through Bot B's projectile and impact, and preserve the guard pose through
        nonlethal damage.
  - kind: gameplay_action
    trigger: Tap Fight Now while the preparation countdown is visible
    response: Hide Fight Now, skip the remaining countdown, show Fight for one second, then begin Player
      A's attack.
    state_change: PREPARATION → FIGHT_NOW → A_ATTACK
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - el.fight_now
    feedback:
      visual: The countdown is replaced by Fight immediately, the button disappears, and the existing
        attack sequence begins after the one-second callout.
  - kind: screen_transition
    trigger: An attack reduces either fighter to zero HP
    response: Play the defeated fighter's death GIF, show the winner callout, and stop combat.
    state_change: ATTACK → RESULT
  - kind: retry
    trigger: Tap Play Again on the result state
    response: Restore both fighters to 100 HP and 5/10 mana, clear attack and defense actions, and begin
      Turn 1 preparation.
    state_change: RESULT → PREPARATION
    target:
      scope: screen_element
      screen_element_ids:
        - el.retry
    feedback:
      visual: Hide result controls, restore health and mana fills, and show the Turn 1 countdown.

random_behaviors:
  - what: Damage per hit
    range: Uniform integer from 10 through 15 inclusive before critical and attack/defense modifiers.
    verify_strategy: Inspect configured bounds and damage math across repeated attacks.
  - what: Critical hit
    range: 15% chance per attack; critical damage is 2x base, then applicable player attack boost or
      defense reduction is applied.
    verify_strategy: Inspect probability and multiplier and compare normal, critical, boosted and
      guarded damage results.
camera_feed_constraints:
  tracking_type: none
  tracking_range: Fixed screen-space moonlit forest stage
  user_image_visible: false
  composition: segmentation_portrait
  composition_option: A
criteria:
  - category: layout
    check: Keep the existing forest scene, both mages and HUD visible in the 9:16 portrait layout; mana
      bars remain below health bars and Attack/Defense buttons stay in their existing positions.
  - category: state
    check: A new play starts at Turn 1 with both HP at 100 and both mana values at 5/10.
  - category: value
    check: At the end of each completed turn both fighters recover 1 mana, capped at 10, and both
      ManaBars match their current values.
  - category: state
    check: Attack_Button is active only when Player A has at least 2 mana, the buff has not been used
      this turn, and Player A has not started the attack; it becomes inactive after use and
      re-evaluates at the next turn.
  - category: value
    check: Activating Attack_Button spends exactly 2 Player mana and applies +75% damage only to Player
      A's attack; critical hits remain multiplicative.
  - category: state
    check: Defense_Button is active only when Player A has at least 3 mana, guard has not been used this
      turn, and Bot B has not started attacking; it becomes inactive after use and re-evaluates next
      turn.
  - category: value
    check: A guarded Bot attack loops the shield animation from attack start through impact, applies 20%
      of final incoming damage, and suppresses the Player hit animation; lethal damage still uses
      the death animation.
  - category: state
    check: After the Fight callout, Player A attacks Bot B first; if Bot B survives, Bot B attacks
      Player A next; the next preparation begins after the exchange.
  - category: value
    check: Normal hits deal 10–15 integer damage; critical hits have a 15% chance and double base damage
      before applicable modifiers.
  - category: state
    check: A lethal hit plays the defeated character's death animation, then displays the correct winner
      and stops combat.
  - category: state
    check: Retry restores HP and mana, clears attack and defense states, and starts Turn 1.
scene_representation:
  planning_mode: explicit
  decision_summary: Preserve the existing 2D forest duel, with once-per-turn mana-funded attack and
    guard actions layered onto the established automated A-then-B turn flow.
  space:
    kind: screen
    description: Existing fixed 9:16 portrait screen-space game.
  content_form:
    kind: flat_2d
    description: Forest artwork, animated Mage GIF textures, screen UI and WaterBall animated textures.
  requirements:
    - id: combat.initial_state
      description: Both fighters start at 100 HP and 5/10 mana, then show the existing Turn 1 preparation
        countdown.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.battle
        - layer.hud
      verification_refs:
        - verify.initial
    - id: combat.order
      description: Player A attacks Bot B first; if Bot B survives, Bot B attacks Player A next.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.battle
      verification_refs:
        - verify.exchange
    - id: combat.projectile
      description: Attacks use the existing growing WaterBall projectile and impact sequence.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.battle
      verification_refs:
        - verify.exchange
    - id: combat.mana
      description: Both mana bars show current values; both fighters gain one mana after each completed
        turn, capped at 10.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.battle
      verification_refs:
        - verify.attack_boost
        - verify.defense
    - id: combat.attack_boost
      description: Before Player A attacks, the player may spend 2 mana once per turn to boost Player A
        damage by 75%; the button disables until the next turn.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.battle
      verification_refs:
        - verify.attack_boost
    - id: combat.defense
      description: Before Bot B attacks, the player may spend 3 mana once per turn to guard; the Mage
        loops the defense animation through impact, takes 20% final damage and skips hit reaction.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.battle
      verification_refs:
        - verify.defense
    - id: combat.damage
      description: Damage is 10–15 base with a 15% chance to double via critical hit; applicable attack
        and defense modifiers follow.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.battle
      verification_refs:
        - verify.attack_boost
        - verify.defense
        - verify.exchange
    - id: combat.death_result
      description: A lethal hit plays the defeated fighter's death animation, displays the correct winner
        and stops combat.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.battle
        - layer.hud
      verification_refs:
        - verify.result
    - id: combat.retry
      description: Retry restores HP, mana and Turn 1 preparation.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.hud
      verification_refs:
        - verify.result
    - id: combat.skip_countdown
      description: Fight Now skips the remaining preparation countdown but retains the one-second Fight callout.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.hud
      verification_refs:
        - verify.fight_now
    - id: combat.controls
      description: Attack_Button and Defense_Button are actionable with mana feedback; Defense_Button
        remains disabled after use until the next turn.
      must: true
      layer_refs:
        - layer.battle
      verification_refs:
        - verify.initial
  layers:
    - id: layer.battle
      role: Battle stage
      description: Existing forest backdrop, mages, health and mana bars, projectile and action controls.
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: Fixed portrait screen space.
      content_form:
        kind: flat_2d
        description: Existing scene images and animated textures.
      requirement_refs:
        - combat.initial_state
        - combat.order
        - combat.projectile
        - combat.mana
        - combat.attack_boost
        - combat.defense
        - combat.damage
        - combat.death_result
        - combat.controls
    - id: layer.hud
      role: Turn and result HUD
      description: TurnText, countdownText, Fight Now and retry controls.
      space:
        kind: screen
        description: Safe-zone anchored UI.
      content_form:
        kind: flat_2d
        description: Text and Image components.
      requirement_refs:
        - combat.initial_state
        - combat.death_result
        - combat.retry
        - combat.skip_countdown
  limitations:
    - Attack_Button buffs Player A only; Bot B uses the existing automatic attack.
    - Defense_Button guards Player A against Bot B only.
  extensions:
    existing_game_contract: Retain the current full-screen authored forest composition.
  fallbacks:
    unknown_requirement: adapt_and_verify
    unmet_must: stop_and_explain
  verification:
    - id: verify.initial
      description: Confirm initial battle and mana state.
      requirement_refs:
        - combat.initial_state
        - combat.controls
      views_or_states:
        - Initial screen
      success_criteria: Turn 1, both HP 100, both mana bars at half, both action buttons active at 5 mana.
    - id: verify.attack_boost
      description: Activate attack boost once and complete the turn.
      requirement_refs:
        - combat.mana
        - combat.attack_boost
        - combat.damage
      views_or_states:
        - Preparation
        - Button dim after tap
        - Player A attack
        - Bot B attack
        - Next preparation
      success_criteria: Tap spends 2 mana, applies 1.75x damage to Player A's hit, disables Attack_Button
        until the next turn and mana regeneration.
    - id: verify.defense
      description: Activate guard, then receive Bot B's attack.
      requirement_refs:
        - combat.mana
        - combat.defense
        - combat.damage
      views_or_states:
        - Preparation with Defense_Button active
        - Button dim after tap
        - Bot B attack animation
        - Shield loop and incoming WaterBall
        - Impact and reduced damage
        - Next preparation
      success_criteria: Tap spends 3 mana, guard animation loops from Bot B attack start through impact,
        Player takes 20% final damage with no hit animation, and the button resets for the next
        turn.
    - id: verify.exchange
      description: Follow the A-then-B attack exchange.
      requirement_refs:
        - combat.order
        - combat.projectile
        - combat.damage
      views_or_states:
        - A wind-up
        - A projectile
        - A impact
        - B wind-up
        - B projectile
        - B impact
        - next preparation
      success_criteria: Attack order, projectile growth and flight, impact, damage, health and mana
        updates follow the contract.
    - id: verify.result
      description: Reach a lethal hit and verify result.
      requirement_refs:
        - combat.death_result
        - combat.retry
      views_or_states:
        - Lethal impact
        - death animation
        - winner state
        - retry
      success_criteria: Only the defeated fighter plays dead, the correct winner appears, combat stops,
        and retry restores the starting state.
    - id: verify.fight_now
      description: Tap Fight Now during preparation.
      requirement_refs:
        - combat.skip_countdown
      views_or_states:
        - Preparation with Fight Now visible
        - Fight callout
        - A attack
      success_criteria: The countdown skips immediately while the Fight callout and normal attack order remain.
plan_type: game
